Demonstration of financing: We are working from an estimated project cost of {top_fix_cost_usd} for {top_fix_name}. We are requesting a grant of {grant_request} from {UNKNOWN: grant program name}, and {name} will pay the remaining {farmer_match} as a cash match from farm revenue, which meets the minimum cash match of {UNKNOWN: required cash match percentage}. Because the grant is paid as a reimbursement, the farm will pay the full project cost upfront using {UNKNOWN: source of upfront financing, such as farm savings, a line of credit or an executed loan} and will be reimbursed for the grant share after installation. We will provide {UNKNOWN: bank reference letter, line of credit letter or other financial documentation} to show that the farm can cover these costs.

Farm-generated revenue is a primary source of our operating income, with greenhouse sales making up {UNKNOWN: share of operating income from farm-generated revenue}. This project supports the continued viability of that production by lowering our largest seasonal operating cost.

Support documents: The application includes the budget for this project area, {UNKNOWN: list of supporting documents attached}, and the proof of available financing described above.
